name: VALSARTAN / AMLODIPINE 160/5 MG 14 TABLETS
description: Valsartan and amlodipine, often used together, are antihypertensive medications that help control high blood pressure. Valsartan blocks the action of angiotensin II, a substance that narrows blood vessels, while amlodipine relaxes blood vessel muscles, making it easier for blood to flow. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
